d.seg: वाशरूम में खुलोगी बेड में जाना है बेड में
d.tr: Will you open in the washroom? You have to go to the bed, to the bed.
d.ctx: The user mentions being alone at home. The speaker then suggests moving to the bed and asks if they will undress.
d.j: The speaker is explicitly asking the other person to 'open' (undress) and move to the bed, which is a strong case of sexual solicitation.
